name: Furious Flame

source.title: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

disable: DC 26 Thievery check (expert) to scratch out the religious iconography, DC 24 Religion check (trained) to pray for safe passage, DC 28 Diplomacy check (expert) to soothe the emotions powering the magical ward, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the magical energy

items.name: Furious Explosion
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the door directly or with a tool; Bypass key

---
Effect The trap explodes in a 15-foot radius burst, dealing 5d10 fire damage to all creatures in the area (DC 26 basic Reflex save save). Creatures damaged by the trap must additionally succeed at a DC 26 Will save save (against a mental effect), becoming Confused for 1 minute on a failure.

text: Religious sigils of Scal carefully carved into the doorframe capture Tokainen's suppressed anger and frustration, unleashing it in a destructive explosion when a creature attempts to open the door.
